verdict: S13 FAIL / STOP per the frozen screen bands (12.89% << 48%). The Bullet 0.75 result-weighted blend on the existing CP corpus is catastrophically worse than CP-only training. Notably the val MAE on pure CP also degraded (166.5 vs 132.8) and the same epoch-2-then-degrade shape persisted — the blend did not fix the early-best pattern either.
interpretation: The 0.75/0.75-blend weights the REAL outcome of ~2300-rated online blitz games heavily over a 16k-node SF18 teacher. Bullet's recipe works with its own data pipeline (self-play + engine-quality games + fresh streams); grafting the blend constant onto our corpus was the cheap test and it failed decisively. Data-supply remains the untested lever (5M+ fresh positions with BOTH signals), but that requires new labeling compute and is NOT authorized this round.
